admin.title: Support Tickets
admin.auto_close_days_help: Tickets that have had no activity for this many days are closed automatically. Allowed values: 1-365.
admin.email_notifications_help: Send an email to the people involved when a ticket is created or a reply is posted.
admin.staff_group_help: Members of the selected group are the support team. They can see every ticket, receive notifications, and new tickets can be assigned to them automatically.
admin.staff_group_none: — Administrators and holders of the “View all support tickets” permission —
admin.auto_assign_help: Hand every new ticket to the support team member with the fewest open tickets.

categories.title: Ticket categories
categories.help: Categories help users pick the right department when they open a ticket. Link a category to a department to route its tickets.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Create one to get started.
categories.load_error: Categories could not be loaded. Please try again.
categories.save_error: The category could not be saved.
categories.delete_error: The category could not be deleted.
categories.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?
categories.field_slug_help: URL-friendly identifier using lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
categories.field_department_help: Tickets in this category are routed to the department's members for assignment and notifications. Leave as "No department" to use the general support team.
categories.field_active_help: Inactive categories are hidden when users open a ticket.

departments.title: Departments
departments.help: Split your support team into departments, add the people that belong to each one, then link categories to them. New tickets are assigned to the department's members and only they get notified.
departments.empty: No departments yet. Create one, add members and link categories to it.
departments.load_error: Departments could not be loaded. Please try again.
departments.deleted: Department deleted and its categories were unlinked.
departments.save_error: The department could not be saved.
departments.delete_error: The department could not be deleted.
departments.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? Categories linked to it will be unlinked and fall back to the general support team.
departments.field_slug_help: URL-friendly identifier using lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
departments.field_active_help: Inactive departments no longer receive tickets; their categories fall back to the general support team.
departments.members_help: Department members receive notifications for tickets in linked categories, and new tickets are assigned to them first. Make sure they hold support permissions (or are in the support team group) so they can open the tickets.
departments.members_empty: No members yet. Search for users above to add them.
departments.members_search_placeholder: Search users by name or username...
departments.search_error: The user search failed. Please try again.
departments.members_save_error: The members could not be saved.

forms.title: Ticket form fields
forms.help: Add your own fields to the ticket form, HESK style. Users fill them in when they open a ticket and the answers are shown inside the ticket.
forms.empty: No custom fields yet. Add one to extend the ticket form.
forms.load_error: Fields could not be loaded. Please try again.
forms.save_error: The field could not be saved.
forms.delete_error: The field could not be deleted.
forms.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the field {label}?
forms.field_label_help: Shown to users on the ticket form.
forms.field_name_help: Internal identifier (letters, numbers and underscores). Generated from the label when left empty.
forms.field_options_help: One choice per line. Used by the select, radio and checkbox types.
forms.field_category_help: Leave as "Every category" to always show the field, or restrict it to a single category.
forms.field_active_help: Inactive fields are hidden on the ticket form.

forum.title: Support Center
forum.subtitle: Create a ticket and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.
forum.category_department_hint: This category is handled by the {department} department.
forum.subject: Subject
forum.upload_too_large: That file is too large. The maximum size is 5 MB.
forum.attachment_hint: Tip: paste an image with Ctrl+V (or ⌘+V) to attach it.
forum.closed_note: This ticket is closed. Reopen it to continue the conversation.
forum.empty_text: When you open a support ticket it will show up here.
forum.error_not_found: Ticket not found or access denied.
forum.error_preferences: Failed to save your notification preference.
forum.guest_title: Sign in to open a support ticket
forum.guest_text: You need an account to open a support ticket and follow its progress. Log in or create a free account to get started.

notifications.label: Support notifications
notifications.help: Receive an alert and an email when a ticket is created or answered.
